title: Valid Card Type Codes
applicability: Applies to Segment 100 Prompt Code card context and to separate Table Load/Special Prompt Code families.

tableLoadResponseCodes.scope: Card acceptance and terminal feature configuration

businessRequirements.title: Financial Segment 100 Prompt Codes shall use one of the 36 Appendix E card types valid for financial transaction Prompt Codes.
A financial Prompt Code shall combine a valid Appendix G transaction type with a valid Appendix E financial card type.
Conoco internal code 89 shall not be used as the merchant Prompt Code; merchant transactions use card type 090.
Special three-character Prompt Codes shall be validated as special transaction artifacts and not accepted as standard financial Segment 100 Prompt Codes.
Table Load Response card type and terminal feature values shall be interpreted using the Appendix E Table Load Response code table, separately from the financial Prompt Code allowlist.
businessRequirements.coverageNote: TableLoadPayloadValidator checks response blocks and the Card Type 173 -> DL6 dependency, but does not validate all 56 Table Load entries.

testDataStatus: Financial card-type oracle and Prompt Code syntactic tests cover all 36 financial card values. Table Load has structural tests and representative code/dependency cases only. Special prompt behaviors are maintained as separate code-9 draft BRs. AI artifact coverage remains pending.
